title: Mixed Strategy Simplex
body_html:
Mixed Strategy Simplex

For a finite set $S$, the mixed strategy simplex $\Delta(S)$ is the set of probability vectors on $S$: $$ \Delta(S)=\{x \in \mathbb{R}^S : x_s \ge 0 \text{ for all } s,\ \sum_{s \in S} x_s = 1\}. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 2, Section 2.3] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Delta(S) is the simplex of probabilities on a finite set S.
